test: CM3 shared memory shows the inbox, dream diff, owner controls and Undo in every layout
expected: the Jevellan web app "CM3 memory dream undone" screen at desktop-light, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "CM3 shared memory shows the inbox, dream diff, owner controls and Undo in every layout"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: The status is repeated: the summary line already says 'Memory dream: undone — Kept the test conventions and consolidated the inbox.', and the next two lines show 'undone' and the same sentence again.
The counts line shows raw camelCase keys ('inboxPromoted: 1 · inboxDropped: 0 · …') instead of readable labels.
The diff panel cuts off at '-updated: …' and needs scrolling inside the panel to see the rest of the diff.
The 'INBOX (FROM TODAY)' heading is cut off at the bottom of the dialog, so you have to scroll to see the inbox section.
There's no visible sign that the dream was undone, such as a badge or a disabled 'Undo' state. Only the word 'undone' in plain text shows it.
